title: Khan Market Delhi - Shopping, Food, Timings & Travel Guide
content:
Khan Market - Delhi,

Khan Market is one of Delhi’s most upscale and iconic shopping destinations. Known for its mix of luxury boutiques, branded stores, cozy cafes, and bookstores, this market is a favorite among diplomats, expats, celebrities, and Delhi’s elite. Unlike the chaos of street markets, Khan Market offers a calm, clean, and organized shopping experience, making it stand out among Delhi’s shopping hubs.

History & Overview:

Established in 1951, Khan Market was originally built to house refugees after Partition. Over the years, it transformed into one of the most expensive retail markets in India, and today it is a symbol of luxury and lifestyle shopping in Delhi.

What Makes It Special:

Khan Market is not just about shopping; it’s about the experience of elegance and charm. From designer wear and international brands to quaint bookshops and organic food stores, it has something for everyone. Its leafy lanes, fine-dining restaurants, and high-end salons make it a perfect spot for lifestyle lovers.

Things to Shop For:

  • Designer clothing and accessories.
  • Imported goods and international brands.
  • Books and stationery from iconic bookstores.
  • Organic foods, cosmetics, and wellness products.
  • Luxury lifestyle products.

Food & Eateries:

Khan Market is as famous for its cafes and restaurants as it is for shopping. From fine dining to casual hangouts, you’ll find everything here. Popular spots include Big Chill Cafe, Town Hall, Smoke House Deli, and Khan Chacha. Whether you’re craving Italian, Asian, North Indian, or quick snacks, this market never disappoints food lovers.

Entry Fee & Timings:

  • Entry Fee: Free.
  • Timings: 10:00 AM – 11:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).

Best Time to Visit: The best time to visit Khan Market is in the evening, when the place is lively with people shopping and enjoying dinner at restaurants. Winters (October – March) are especially pleasant for strolling around.

How to Reach:

  • Nearest Metro Station: Khan Market Metro Station (Violet Line)
  • By Road: Well-connected by taxis, autos, and buses.
  • Parking: Paid parking is available but often limited due to high demand. Arriving early is advised.

Places to Visit Nearby:

  • Lodhi Garden.
  • India Gate.
  • Humayun’s Tomb.
  • Dilli Haat (INA).

Travel Tips:

  • Prices are on the higher side, so it’s not a budget shopping place.
  • Ideal for those looking for branded products and fine dining.
  • Parking can be a challenge, especially on weekends-prefer metro or cab.
  • Bookstores here are a must-visit for book lovers.
excerpt: Khan Market is a blend of luxury shopping, elegant cafes, and cultural charm, making it one of Delhi’s most prestigious shopping hubs. While it may not be budget-friendly, it offers a unique and classy experience that sets it apart from other markets in Delhi.
